title: Darwin: Evolution Revolution
description: The naturalist who forever changed how we understand life on Earth through natural selection
imageHint: 🐒 From Galápagos finches to the tree of life 🌳

questions.question: What is the title of Darwin's groundbreaking 1859 book that introduced the theory of evolution?
acceptedAnswers: on the origin of species by means of natural selection
questions.hint: It's about the 'origin' of all living things and their different types

questions.question: Which Pacific island chain provided Darwin with crucial evidence for evolution, especially the finches?
questions.hint: These volcanic islands are off the coast of Ecuador, famous for unique species

questions.question: What is the term for Darwin's principle that organisms best adapted to their environment survive and reproduce?
questions.hint: Nature 'selects' the best traits, or only the 'fittest' survive

questions.question: On which famous ship did young Darwin serve as the naturalist during his five-year voyage?
questions.hint: Named after a type of hunting dog, this royal navy ship sailed around the world

questions.question: Darwin delayed publishing his theory for decades partly due to conflict with his religious beliefs. What was his original field of study?
questions.hint: He originally studied to become a clergyman and understand God's word

deeperMode.title: Darwin's Tormented Genius
deeperMode.description: The personal struggles and obsessive details behind the theory that shook the world

questions.question: Darwin kept a detailed 'thinking path' in his garden where he would walk while pondering evolution. What did he call this path?
questions.hint: He would drop pebbles to count his laps while deep in thought about natural selection

questions.question: What chronic illness plagued Darwin for most of his adult life, possibly caused by stress over his revolutionary theory?
questions.hint: Modern doctors think it was stress-related, causing stomach problems and exhaustion
